mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO content_report (report_id, target_type, target_id, author_id, reporter_id, reason, content_snapshot, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{authorId}, #{reporterId}, #{reason}, #{contentSnapshot}, 'PENDING', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE content_report SET status = 'PROCESSED', handler_id = #{handlerId}, handled_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE content_report SET status = 'IGNORED', handler_id = #{handlerId}, handled_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT report_id, target_type, target_id, author_id, reporter_id, reason, content_snapshot, status, handler_id, handled_at, create_time, update_time FROM content_report WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
